trajectory_summary: This is a short, mechanical verify-and-book call: the rep moves through qualification items in order, hits a genuine detour on utility-company identification, and closes with a booked Monday 5pm phone appointment. Energy neither builds meaningfully nor leaks badly — the customer stays cooperative throughout, but the rep never engages beyond box-checking, leaving real value (the prior-contact thread, the bill figure, a proper button-up) on the table.
outcome_dispute: The v1 tag is unknown/unclear; the observed transcript supports a clear 'booked' outcome — a specific day (Monday) and time (5:00) are agreed and confirmed by the customer at 06:54.

observed_outcome.reasoning: A specific day (Monday) and time (5:00) are explicitly agreed by the customer, and the rep confirms it back at 06:56 ('So we'll call you Monday at five'), satisfying the booked-outcome criteria. No co-owner was identified since the customer confirmed no one else is on the title.
